responsibility: This header declares the pretty-printing abstraction used by the mc code generator. It defines the opaque pretty-printer handle and write callback records and exports operations for creating, duplicating, stacking, destroying, configuring indentation and spacing, querying current output position, and printing raw or escape-aware text, forming the public formatting interface for generated source emission.
same_name_distinction: This .h file publishes the opaque pretty-printer type and callback signatures used by GmcPretty.cc, exposing the formatting operations while hiding the internal structure that stores indentation, cursor state, and stacked copies.
